title: Chilli Mac'n'Cheese
description: Spiced minced beef, kidney beans and macaroni simmered in stock and tomatoes, then finished under the grill with melted Cheddar.
ingredients: 400g can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
Spice mix: 1 tsp chilli powder, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp onion granules, 1 tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt
steps: Mix all spices together in a small bowl.
Fry onion and garlic gently in cooking spray for 3 minutes. Add peppers; fry 1 more minute.
Add minced meat; cook until brown, breaking it up. Stir in spice mix thoroughly.
Add tomatoes, tomato purée, kidney beans and Worcestershire sauce; stir.
Pour in stock and macaroni; stir well. Lid on; simmer gently 15 minutes until macaroni is cooked. Remove lid; bubble gently for last few minutes; stir. Preheat grill.
Remove from heat; stir in half the cheese. Sprinkle rest on top; grill ~5 minutes until bubbling and browned.
notes: Replace kidney beans with black beans, pinto beans or haricot beans. Stir through some mozzarella before grilling for extra stringy cheese.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
